text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having some business with her, I went up 
to the rooftop in search of Narita 
Taishin, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, another ad? Annoying... I can't make 
any progress in the game at all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? "Feel the effects in just 3 days!" 
"Old dead skin peels right off!" 
"Transform into radiant, beautiful skin"?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list:
Don't go buying dangerous things, 
alright!?
You shouldn't buy dangerous things, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Don't scare me like that...! Like 
I'd actually fall for some ad?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she said that, on the inside, she 
was apparently worried about her skin 
breaking out...
